Project: P2P (Person to Person) Transfer                                                                                               Jan 2013 – Nov 2014 
Client: Bank of America, USA                                                                                                                 Role: Technology Lead 
Organization: Infosys 
  
P2P Gen2 is an extension of the current Bank of America P2P product offering, enabling customers to send P2P 
payments to anyone using an alias vs their routing and account number, regardless of whether they currently have 
an account with BAC or another Financial Institution.  If the receiving party does not have an account with either FI 
on the network, the customer would have to open an account with either FI to collect funds. Enhance existing P2P 
functionality to allow for closed loop network transfers between Bank of America and another financial institution.
